environment.description: Application deployed in EKS cluster (v1.28) behind ALB Ingress Controller. The ALB has AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with rule group evaluation order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to Count, (2) custom rule 'corp-query-param-regex' with RegexPatternSet matching field QUERY_STRING with patterns including '(?i)(union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|;|--|/\*|\*/|\bor\b\s+\d|\band\b\s+\d|case\s+when|if\s*\()' at priority 2 in BLOCK mode with 403 response, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 5 in COUNT mode only (used for metrics). The custom regex rule inspects SingleQueryArgument on all query parameters via scope-down statement matching URI path '/api/'. Additionally, the Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts pod egress to only kube-dns on UDP/53 and the pod's own localhost, preventing any out-of-band data exfiltration channels.
